node.statement: Uniform amplified setup: there are universal k_co<infinity and e_0>0 such that, for e<=e_0, writing A_n=M_n tensor A and R_n=I_n tensor R, the four amplified projections P_{1,n},P_n,Q_{1,n},Q_n are delta-projections of norm at most B:=3, satisfy ||P_n P_{1,n}-P_{1,n}||<=delta and ||Q_{1,n}Q_n-Q_{1,n}||<=delta, and every pair of delta-projections R,S in A_n obeys ||Co_{R,S}(Z)-R(ZS)||<=k_co e||Z|| and ||Co_{R,S}(Z)-(RZ)S||<=k_co e||Z||.
